title: Offer bee-verifying when a repo declares no test command
action: Make onboard actually OFFER the verification skill (per D5). Today it cannot: notices.rs:203 nests the whole no-test warning inside `if commands.contains_key("verify")`, so a repo that never carried the legacy commands.verify key — every repo onboarded since 2.1.0, which is the entire population this offer aims at — receives no notice. Add ONE new notice, emitted whenever .bee/config.json declares no usable commands.test, independent of the retired-verify branch and never doubling it: when the legacy key IS present the existing RETIRED_VERIFY_KEY_NO_TEST_WARNING already covers that repo, so the new notice must not fire alongside it. Reuse the has_test predicate already written at notices.rs:205-207 (a non-empty string OR an array) rather than writing a second definition of 'declared'. The new notice tells the AGENT to offer bee-verifying to the user — it names the skill and says the offer is the user's to accept, never the agent's to assume. Write it in plain user-facing language, not bee mechanics: AGENTS.md forbids surfacing .bee/config.json, 'commands', or 'CI status gate' to a person, and notices are printed verbatim to stdout by onboard/mod.rs, so a lazy agent leaks whatever this string says. Do NOT generate anything, do NOT touch commands.test, and do NOT add a door or a gate — onboard offers, it never generates.

truths: A repo with no commands.verify key and no commands.test receives the new notice
A repo with a legacy commands.verify key and no commands.test receives exactly one notice, the existing retired-verify one, never both
A repo that declares a usable commands.test receives neither notice
The new notice names bee-verifying and states the offer is the user's to accept
The new notice contains no .bee path, no config key name and no bee-internal term

artifacts.substantive: the new notice constant, plain language, no bee mechanics
the emit condition, outside the retired-verify branch, reusing the existing has_test predicate

key_links: the new notice and RETIRED_VERIFY_KEY_NO_TEST_WARNING are mutually exclusive by construction
prohibitions: onboard generates nothing and runs no skill
commands.test is not read for writing, only for presence
no new door, gate, verb or proof tier
the existing retired-verify notices are not reworded or removed

trace.outcome: onboard now offers bee-verifying to any repo declaring no test command, mutually exclusive with the retired-verify warnings
deviations: Added five tests to notices.rs and isolated the existing stale_advisor_key_is_reported fixture by giving it a test command — the cell named no test work, but the retired-verify branch had zero coverage and the advisor test asserted a full notice list that the new notice legitimately joins — something else had to be fixed first

mistakes.better: I should have checked for a rustfmt config and the declared test command first, before spending a run on a gate this repo does not have
